subject: Financial Management and Strategic Management
paper_name: Paper-6: Financial Management and Strategic Management
question_text:
10. Use McKinsey's 7S Model to identify the soft elements that change during
reinvention.
(i)  Shared value
(ii)  Style
(iii)  Strategy
(iv)  Staff
(A)  Only (i) and (ii) are correct.
(B)  Only (i), (iii) and (iv) are correct.
(C)  (i), (ii), (iii) and (iv) are correct.
(D)  Only (i), (ii) and (iv) are correct.
(2 Marks)

6
